Two Decades of Quantitative Excellence

Since 2003, TraceSeis has been helping exploration and production teams make better decisions through rigorous, science-based reservoir characterization.

Our Story

TraceSeis was founded in Houston in 2003 with a clear mission: bring quantitative rigor to seismic interpretation by applying established rock physics principles and advanced computational methods.

From the beginning, we recognized that the value of seismic data lies not in pretty pictures, but in its ability to quantitatively constrain reservoir properties. This philosophy drives everything we do - from our consulting projects to our software development.

Today, TraceSeis serves exploration and production companies worldwide, providing the technical expertise and tools needed to reduce uncertainty and improve drilling success rates.

Leadership

TraceSeis is led by experienced geoscientists with deep expertise in quantitative interpretation and rock physics.

Alvaro Chaveste

Founder & CEO

With decades of experience in quantitative seismic interpretation and rock physics, Alvaro founded TraceSeis to bring rigorous scientific methods to reservoir characterization. His expertise spans seismic inversion, AVO analysis, and lithofacies prediction across diverse geological settings.

Alvaro Chaveste II

Business Development Lead

Alvaro II leads TraceSeis business development efforts, working with clients to understand their challenges and match them with the right solutions. His focus is on building long-term partnerships that deliver measurable value.

Houston, Texas

TraceSeis is headquartered in Houston, the global center of the energy industry. Our location provides direct access to operators, service companies, and research institutions that drive innovation in subsurface characterization.

While based in Houston, we serve clients worldwide, with project experience spanning North America, South America, West Africa, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific.
